name: Simulanka
description: Simulanka was a limited time summer event area featured in Version 4.8 during the Summertide Scales and Tales event. The world of Simulanka was created by Alice, Barbeloth, and Andersdotter, three members of the Hexenzirkel; they are known by Simulanka's people as the Goddesses of Creation, Prophecy, and Fate respectively.[1] Alice brought the Traveler, Paimon, Nilou, Kirara, Navia, and Wanderer to Simulanka to experience its story.
